column2: Brush teeth with Moss!
Wash hands!
My day!
Healthy plate!
Tidy up time!
Dress for the weather!
Let's brush our teeth together! Put a little toothpaste on your brush. Just a tiny dot, like a pea.
Ready? Tap the toothbrush, and we'll start!
Let's start with the top teeth on this side. Little circles!
Now the top teeth on the other side. Round and round.
Now the bottom teeth on this side. Little circles!
And the bottom teeth on the other side.
Now the front teeth. Show me a big smile, and brush, brush, brush!
And the tongue too! Gently, very gently.
Little circles, nice and gentle.
Don't forget the teeth at the back!
You're doing so well. Keep going!
Slow and steady, just like me.
Bye bye, sugar bugs!
Sparkly clean! Now spit, rinse, and show me your big smile!
Let's wash our hands, just like at the sink!
First, wet your hands with water.
Now take some soap. Lots of bubbles!
Rub your palms together. Let's count!
Now the backs of your hands.
In between your fingers, like a little hug.
Now wash each thumb. Round and round.
And scrub your fingertips on your palm. Scritch, scratch!
Rinse off all the bubbles.
Now dry your hands with a towel. Pat, pat, pat.
Clean hands! Fresh and ready. Well done!
Good morning! Let's do our morning steps together.
Good evening. Let's get ready for bed, one step at a time.
When you've done it, tap the picture and it gets a gold star.
Time to wake up! Give a big stretch, up to the sky.
Good morning, sunshine!
Time to use the toilet.
Well done! And remember to wash your hands.
Let's wash your hands and face.
All fresh and clean!
Time to get dressed.
You look lovely today!
Time for breakfast! Yum.
A good breakfast makes you strong!
Time to brush your teeth.
Well done, teeth are shiny!
Let's brush your hair.
So neat and tidy!
Shoes and jacket on.
All ready to go outside!
Let's drink some water.
Glug, glug! That was good.
Time to tidy up the toys.
Every toy is home. Thank you!
Time for dinner.
Yum! What a tasty dinner.
Bath time! Splish, splash.
All clean and cozy!
Let's put on your pyjamas.
Soft and snuggly pyjamas!
Time for a story.
What a lovely story.
A big goodnight hug!
Mmm. Hugs are the best.
Lights off. Time to sleep.
Sleep tight, little one.
All done! You're ready for a lovely day!
All done. Sweet dreams, little friend.
Some foods we eat every day. They help us grow big and strong. Some foods are treats, just for special days.
Everyday foods go in the basket with the leaf. Treats go in the basket with the star.
Yes! An everyday food.
Yes! A treat, for special days.
Hmm, that one is an everyday food! It goes in the leaf basket.
That one is a treat. Treats go in the star basket.
Now let's make a rainbow plate for me! Lots of colors are good for us.
Can you find something red?
Now something orange!
Can you find something yellow?
Now something green!
And something purple!
A rainbow plate! So many colors. Yum, yum, thank you!
Corn!
Eggplant!
Peas!
Candy!
Chips!
Lollipop!
Oh, what a mess! Let's tidy up. Every toy has a home.
Oops, the toys are out again. Let's tidy up!
Let's put the teddy in the toy box!
The ball goes in the toy box.
The block goes in the toy box.
Brrm, brrm! The car goes in the toy box.
The drum goes in the toy box.
The book goes on the bookshelf.
The red book goes on the bookshelf.
The blue book goes on the bookshelf.
Quack! The duck goes in the bath basket.
The boat goes in the bath basket.
The fish goes in the bath basket.
Ahh. So nice and tidy. It feels cozy now.
Everything is home. Now there's lots of room to play!
What a tidy room! Thank you for helping.
Tuka wants to go outside! Let's look out of the window and help her get dressed.
It's sunny and warm today! What should Tuka wear?
It's raining! Pitter patter. What does Tuka need?
Look, it's snowing! Brr. What will keep Tuka warm?
Whoosh! It's very windy. What should Tuka wear?
A raincoat keeps you dry!
Boots on! Ready for puddles.
An umbrella! Drip, drop, no rain on your head.
A sun hat, for shade from the sun.
Sunglasses! So cool.
A light t-shirt for a warm day.
A woolly hat keeps your ears warm.
A cozy scarf for your neck.
Mittens for warm paws!
A warm jacket, zipped up tight.
Tuka is ready for the sunshine!
Tuka is ready to splash in the rain!
Tuka is warm and ready for the snow!
Tuka is ready for the wind. Whoosh!
It's hot and sunny! A woolly hat would be much too warm.
Mittens are for cold days. Today is warm!
No rain today! A raincoat would be too hot.
It's warm today. No scarf needed!
It's grey and rainy. Sunglasses won't keep you dry.
A sun hat would get all soggy! What keeps the rain off?
A t-shirt would get wet. What keeps you dry?
Brr, it's snowy! A sun hat won't keep you warm.
Brr! A t-shirt is too chilly for snow.
An umbrella won't keep you warm. What keeps your ears and paws cozy?
Whoosh! The wind would blow the umbrella away!
Whoosh! The wind would blow that hat away!
It's windy and chilly. A t-shirt is not warm enough.
